app.name: NanoPrint
app.tagline: Local print agent for thermal receipt printers
settings.title: Settings
settings.general.title: General
settings.language.label: Language
settings.language.description: Follows the system language unless another one is chosen.
settings.autostart.label: Start with the system
settings.autostart.description: Run NanoPrint in the background after signing in.
settings.server.failed: The print server is not running: {message}
settings.sites.title: Sites
settings.sites.description: Websites that asked to print. Access can be revoked at any time.
settings.sites.empty: No website has asked to print yet.
permission.title: Allow printing?
permission.message: This site wants to print to the printers on this computer.
permission.httpsOnly: Only HTTPS sites can be remembered; this decision lasts until NanoPrint closes.
settings.https.title: Secure sites (https)
settings.https.description: Pages whose address starts with https need this once, so they can print.
settings.https.untrusted: Not enabled: secure sites cannot print yet.
settings.https.firefox: On Linux, Firefox does not support this step yet.
settings.history.description: Events from the last 30 days. Printed content is never stored.
history.reason.missing_host: The request did not say which server it was for.
history.reason.foreign_host: The request was addressed to another server (possible DNS rebinding).
history.reason.missing_origin: The client did not identify its page (not a web browser).
history.reason.invalid_origin: The origin is not a web page (file, extension or malformed).
onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome to NanoPrint
onboarding.welcome.running: NanoPrint is running. You will find it in the system tray, next to the clock.
onboarding.welcome.autostart: It starts with the computer, so it is ready whenever you need it. You can turn this off in Preferences.
onboarding.welcome.permission: When a page wants to print, NanoPrint asks you first.
onboarding.refused.title: One more step to print
onboarding.refused.message: A secure page tried to print, but secure sites are not enabled yet.
onboarding.secure.title: Print from secure sites
onboarding.secure.description: Pages whose address starts with https need this once.
onboarding.secure.confirmWindows: Windows will ask you to confirm: choose “Yes”.
onboarding.secure.confirmMac: macOS will ask for your password.
onboarding.secure.done: Done: secure sites can print now.
onboarding.secure.doneReload: Done. Go back to the page and reload it to print.
onboarding.secure.failed: It was not enabled. You can try again, now or later from the panel.
settings.about.title: About
settings.about.license: NanoPrint is free software under the GPL-3.0 license. Source code: github.com/nanofactura/nanoprint.
settings.about.logsDescription: If something goes wrong, attach it to your report. It stays on this computer.
history.reason.network_printer: Network printers must be added in NanoPrint first.
history.reason.printer_not_found: The printer is not installed on this computer (renamed or removed?).
history.reason.printer_hidden: The printer is not offered to sites (Printers tab).
error.code.certificate_not_ready: The certificate is still being prepared; try again in a few seconds
error.code.trust_tool_missing: The certutil tool is missing: install the libnss3-tools (or nss-tools) package
error.code.trust_failed: The system did not make the change
error.code.storage: Could not read or write NanoPrint’s data
error.code.log_folder: Could not open the log folder
error.code.printers_unavailable: Could not get the list of printers
error.code.printer_not_found: The printer is no longer installed
error.code.print_failed: The printer did not accept the job
error.code.virtual_printer: It is a virtual printer: it makes files or sends faxes, not tickets
error.code.easy_print_printer: It is a Remote Desktop printer with Easy Print, which cannot receive tickets
error.code.port_invalid: Ports must be numbers from 1024 to 65535
error.code.ports_equal: The two ports must be different
onboarding.welcome.trayWindows: If you don’t see it, it is under the ^ arrow next to the clock. To keep it in sight, drag its icon onto the taskbar.
settings.printers.description: Printers installed on this computer. Sites only see the ones you offer them.
settings.printers.empty: No printers installed. Add the printer in the system settings, then refresh.
settings.printers.virtual: Virtual printer: it makes files or sends faxes, not tickets.
settings.printers.easyPrint: Remote Desktop printer (Easy Print): it cannot receive tickets. To use it, install its driver on this computer and turn off Easy Print.
settings.printers.testSent: Test page sent to {printer}. If nothing comes out, check that it is on, connected and has paper.
settings.printers.testHint: The test page is meant for thermal printers (ESC/POS): others may print it wrong or not at all.
printers.testPage.title: Test page
printers.testPage.check: If you can read this, the printer works with NanoPrint.
settings.ports.title: Connection ports
settings.ports.description: Leave them empty to use the ones qz-tray.js looks for. With other ports, pages have to name them when they connect.
settings.ports.restartNeeded: NanoPrint uses the new ports after it restarts.
